description: Submit a toll-free number's verification so it can text US and Canadian phones: number, businessName, website, email, useCaseCategories / useCase, useCaseSummary, messageSample, optInType / optInWorkflow, optInImageUrls, messageVolume (e.g. 1,000), and the business address, contact and registration details the provider asks for. Without confirm:true nothing is submitted. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: submit_tollfree_verification
title: Submit toll-free verification
